others.route: Autorisation de travail (Direction du Travail et de l’Emploi)

note: New Caledonia: anyone without French nationality, EU citizens included, needs a work authorisation from New Caledonia's government, applied for before arrival at a French embassy or consulate on a contract with a local employer, who must first offer the job through the public placement services. No exemption for performers was found, so no days without it. French citizens are home; EU citizens are asked like everyone else, the EU's free movement not reaching the territory.

sources.title: Direction du Travail et de l’Emploi de Nouvelle-Calédonie, Main d'œuvre étrangère : vos droits et obligations (2018)
sources.said: QUI DOIT DEMANDER UNE AUTORISATION DE TRAVAIL ? ... Tout ressortissant ne possédant pas la nationalité française y compris les ressortissants de l’Union Européenne.
